view.free_cases_hint: Earned from epic achievements. One opens any case on the shelf — Elite included — without spending Fame.

lock.reason: {{rarity}} gear goes in your rig at level {{lvl}}. Until then it is yours to keep, sell and work on — just not to play.

sort_hint.manual: Your own arrangement — drag pieces wherever you want them
sort_hint.equipped: What you are playing first: profile guitar, rig slots and pedalboard
sort_hint.rarity: Rarest first, copies side by side
sort_hint.type: Guitars first, then pedals, then mods and parts

collection.empty: Your collection is empty. Open a case to start!

salvage.title: Salvage
salvage.fit_body: Onto {{target}}, at the value it was salvaged with. Nothing is re-rolled.
salvage.fit_note: Costs nothing — you already paid {{source}} for it. Taking it off again means scrapping whatever it goes into.

mod_listing_body.guitar: Fits any guitar with a mod slot free, and goes on at +{{points}} with nothing re-rolled. The workshop cannot build one of these — a mod only ever changes hands.
mod_listing_body.effect: Fits any pedal with a mod slot free, and goes on at +{{points}} with nothing re-rolled. The workshop cannot build one of these — a mod only ever changes hands.

mod_owned_body.guitar: Drag it onto any guitar that lights up and it goes on at the value it carries: nothing to pay, nothing re-rolled. It is also waiting on the workshop bench.
mod_owned_body.effect: Drag it onto any pedal that lights up and it goes on at the value it carries: nothing to pay, nothing re-rolled. It is also waiting on the workshop bench.

market.mod_price_hint: The minimum is only what the bin pays. Nobody can build a mod, so price it against what the Trader charges for one.
market.fee_short: Not enough Fame for the {{fee}} listing fee.

parts.card_body: Spent on the workshop bench — builds, repairs and mods all bill in parts. Selling is for what the bench will never ask for.
parts.wallet_empty: Scrap a guitar or pedal from your collection to salvage your first parts.

stash.reason_off_board: Take it off the pedalboard first
stash.title: Stash
stash.tidy_hint: Lay the whole stash out again in one go — it stays your arrangement afterwards
stash.dupes_guitars_hint: Sell or scrap every lower-level duplicate guitar, keeping the best copy of each
stash.dupes_pedals_hint: Sell or scrap every lower-level duplicate pedal, keeping the best copy of each
stash.pedals_protected: Pedals on your pedalboard are never touched.

card.guild_hint: Leave it in your guild's stash, for honor

guitar.scrap_unrig: Remove from rig slot {{slot}} before scrapping

bulk.body: This takes {{n}} lower-level duplicates, keeping the best copy of each.

workhorse.label: Workhorse
workhorse.description: Fame/h on any practice, whatever you play.

long-take.label: Long Take
long-take.description: Fame/h on any practice, whatever you play.

reliable.label: Reliable
reliable.description: Fame/h on any practice. No conditions, no surprises.

jazz-box.label: Jazz Box
jazz-box.description: Fame/h on theory practice. Built for chords, not for speed.

intonation-monster.label: Intonation Monster
intonation-monster.description: Fame/h on ear training. It holds pitch all the way up the neck.

ear-trainer.label: Ear Trainer
ear-trainer.description: Fame/h on ear training. Set a repeat and chase it.

timing-trainer.label: Timing Trainer
timing-trainer.description: Fame/h on technique practice. Lock the repeats to your tempo.

frequency-work.label: Frequency Work
frequency-work.description: Fame/h on ear training. Learn where the bands sit.

picking-bench.label: Picking Bench
picking-bench.description: Fame/h while the session trains Alternate Picking.

legato-neck.label: Legato Neck
legato-neck.description: Fame/h while the session trains Legato.

bender.label: Bender
bender.description: Fame/h while the session trains Bending.

vibrato-arm.label: Vibrato Arm
vibrato-arm.description: Fame/h while the session trains Vibrato.

chord-shop.label: Chord Shop
chord-shop.description: Fame/h while the session trains Chords.

scale-runner.label: Scale Runner
scale-runner.description: Fame/h while the session trains Scales.

metronome.label: Metronome
metronome.description: Fame/h while the session trains Rhythm.

phrase-repeat.label: Phrase Repeat
phrase-repeat.description: Fame/h while the session trains Phrasing. A delay hands your own phrase back to you.

harmony-ear.label: Harmony Ear
harmony-ear.description: Fame/h while the session trains Harmony Ear.

interval-trainer.label: Interval Trainer
interval-trainer.description: Fame/h while the session trains Ear Training.

improv-pedal.label: Improv Pedal
improv-pedal.description: Fame/h while the session trains Improvisation.

phrase-machine.label: Phrase Machine
phrase-machine.description: Fame/h while the session trains Phrasing.

improv-room.label: Improv Room
improv-room.description: Fame/h while the session trains Improvisation.

theory-board.label: Theory Board
theory-board.description: Fame/h while the session trains Music Theory.

brand-endorsement.label: {{brand}} Endorsement
brand-endorsement.description: Fame/h for every {{brand}} item you have in service. Up to three count.

pedal-platform.label: Pedal Platform
pedal-platform.description: Fame/h for every pedal on your board. Up to six count. It does not fight what you put in front of it.

backline.label: Backline
backline.description: Fame/h for every other guitar in your slots.

vintage-row.label: Vintage Row
vintage-row.description: Fame/h for every item in service built before 1985. Up to four count.

boutique-row.label: Boutique Row
boutique-row.description: Fame/h for every Epic-or-better pedal on your board. Up to four count.

bench-boss.label: Bench Boss
bench-boss.description: Fame/h for every build level on the other items in your rig. Up to twenty count.

well-equipped.label: Well Equipped
well-equipped.description: Fame/h for every other trait in your rig. Up to eight count.

wants-dirt.label: Wants Dirt
wants-dirt.description: Fame/h while any Overdrive, Distortion or Fuzz sits on your board. Passive humbuckers need something to push them.

clean-machine.label: Clean Machine
clean-machine.description: Fame/h while your board carries no drive pedal at all. Everything your hands do is audible.

solo-act.label: Solo Act
solo-act.description: Fame/h while this is the only guitar you have equipped.

straight-to-amp.label: Straight to Amp
straight-to-amp.description: Fame/h while your pedalboard is completely empty.

cable-and-amp.label: Cable and Amp
cable-and-amp.description: Fame/h while your pedalboard is completely empty. Nothing between the strings and the speaker.

nothing-but-the-guitar.label: Nothing But the Guitar
nothing-but-the-guitar.description: Fame/h while your pedalboard is completely empty. It does not need help and it never did.

matched-set.label: Matched Set
matched-set.description: Fame/h while another item of the same brand is in service.

ambient-pair.label: Ambient Pair
ambient-pair.description: Fame/h while a Delay and a Reverb are both on the board. Apart they do half the job.

gain-stack.label: Gain Stack
gain-stack.description: Fame/h while a second drive pedal shares the board. Stacking drives is a method, not an accident.

front-of-chain.label: Front of Chain
front-of-chain.description: Fame/h while this pedal sits ahead of every drive on the board. Fuzz and compression want the raw pickup.

tail-of-chain.label: Tail of Chain
tail-of-chain.description: Fame/h while this pedal sits behind every drive on the board. Time effects go last or it turns to mud.

purist.label: Purist
purist.description: Fame/h while your board holds two pedals or fewer.

full-board.label: Full Board
full-board.description: Fame/h while your board holds six pedals or more.

metal-rig.label: Metal Rig
metal-rig.description: Fame/h when two or more drive pedals are on the board and the session has at least 45 minutes of technique.

ambient-study.label: Ambient Study
ambient-study.description: Fame/h when a Reverb shares the board and the session has at least 30 minutes of ear training.

writing-room.label: Writing Room
writing-room.description: Fame/h when your board holds two pedals or fewer and the session has at least 45 minutes of creativity.

practice-room.label: Practice Room
practice-room.description: Fame/h when this is your only equipped guitar and the session runs 60 minutes or longer.

theory-desk.label: Theory Desk
theory-desk.description: Fame/h when a Tuner shares the board and the session has at least 30 minutes of theory.

session-rig.label: Session Rig
session-rig.description: Fame/h when all three guitar slots are filled and the session has at least 15 minutes in three different categories.

fuzz-workout.label: Fuzz Workout
fuzz-workout.description: Fame/h when this pedal sits before every other drive and the session has at least 45 minutes of technique.

modulation-study.label: Modulation Study
modulation-study.description: Fame/h when a Delay shares the board and the session trains Phrasing.

vintage-session.label: Vintage Session
vintage-session.description: Fame/h when three items in service were built before 1985 and the session runs 45 minutes or longer.

stack-study.label: Stack Study
stack-study.description: Fame/h when a second drive pedal shares the board and the session trains Alternate Picking.

tone-lab.label: Tone Lab
tone-lab.description: Fame/h when four or more pedals are on the board and the session has at least 30 minutes of creativity.

quiet-room.label: Quiet Room
quiet-room.description: Fame/h when your board is empty and the session has at least 45 minutes of ear training.

monk.label: Monk
monk.description: Fame/h when your pedalboard is empty, this is your only equipped guitar, and the session is a single category.

virtuoso.label: Virtuoso
virtuoso.description: Fame/h when the session trains Alternate Picking, Legato and Sweep Picking, and has at least 60 minutes of technique.

conservatory.label: Conservatory
conservatory.description: Fame/h when the session trains Music Theory, Harmony and Chords, and runs 60 minutes or longer.

total-recall.label: Total Recall
total-recall.description: Fame/h when the session trains Ear Training and Harmony Ear, and a Reverb and a Tuner are both on the board.

brand-artist.label: {{brand}} Artist
brand-artist.description: Fame/h when every guitar in your slots is {{brand}} and the session runs 45 minutes or longer.

wall-of-sound.label: Wall of Sound
wall-of-sound.description: Fame/h when six or more pedals are on the board, three of them Epic or better, and the session runs 60 minutes or longer.

time-capsule.label: Time Capsule
time-capsule.description: Fame/h when every item in service was built before 1985 and the session runs 45 minutes or longer.

one-man-band.label: One Man Band
one-man-band.description: Fame/h when the session has at least 15 minutes in all four categories and your board holds four pedals or more.

arranger.label: Arranger
arranger.description: Fame/h when the session trains Improvisation, Phrasing and Harmony, and runs 60 minutes or longer.

signal-booster.label: Signal Booster
signal-booster.description: Every other pedal on your board pays this much more Fame/h on each of its traits.

master-class.label: Master Class
master-class.description: Every ear-training and theory trait in your rig pays this much more Fame/h.

drive-trainer.label: Drive Trainer
drive-trainer.description: Every technique trait in your rig pays this much more Fame/h.

skill-coach.label: Skill Coach
skill-coach.description: Every skill-based trait in your rig pays this much more Fame/h.

patchbay.label: Patchbay
patchbay.description: Every pedal further down the chain than this one pays this much more Fame/h on each of its traits.

house-band.label: House Band
house-band.description: Every trait on items sharing this guitar's brand pays this much more Fame/h.

session-leader.label: Session Leader
session-leader.description: Your single highest-paying trait pays this much more Fame/h.

temperamental.label: Temperamental
temperamental.description: Fame/h, but pays nothing when the session runs under 30 minutes.

diva.label: Diva
diva.description: Fame/h, but every trait on your other equipped items pays 9.0 Fame/h less.

prima-donna.label: Prima Donna
prima-donna.description: Fame/h, but every other trait in your rig pays nothing.

body.Guitar: {{name}} — this is permanent, the guitar is gone for good.
body.Effect: {{name}} — this is permanent, the effect is gone for good.
